integrity: Exact matrices and unimodular Smith operations are embedded and checked by the Python standard-library verifier. All eleven cycle partitions have positive integral Smith diagonals with divisibility.
scientific_limitations: Smooth genus-two sextic models in odd characteristic, with graph-critical-group Frobenius invariants only. Does not classify geometric Jacobian rational points or all finite-field realizability patterns. Historic priority not independently certified.
title: Eleven arithmetic fixed critical groups of the genus-two Kummer node–trope graph
